title: Army Ants Build Living Bridges With Their Bodies, With No Leader

scenes.text: These ants build bridges out of their own bodies. Nobody tells them to.
They're army ants, marching in huge raiding columns across the forest floors of Central and South America.
When a gap slows the traffic, ants link their bodies into a living bridge while others cross over them.
No ant knows how big the gap is. Each one only feels its neighbors.
The bridge grows until too many workers are tied up, then the ants let go.
A bridge with no architect, built by the traffic itself.

description:
Army ants link their bodies into living bridges across gaps in the forest, with no leader in charge.
Each ant only reacts to its neighbors, yet the colony builds the bridge only as big as it can afford.
What would you build if you had no boss?
first_comment: Could humans build anything this way with no leader?
